missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Миг' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the predicate noun after 'был'. 'Счастливый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Миг' is inanimate, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'запомнил'. 'Этот' and 'короткий' agree in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Мига' is the genitive form after the negated 'не теряй' reinforced by 'ни'. 'Времени' is the genitive complement of measure.
Strategic focus: Dative of time point. 'Мигу' takes the dative after 'к', marking the moment by which everyone tired. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Мигом' takes the instrumental to mean in an instant. 'Одним' agrees in the masculine instrumental, stressing the speed of the change.

missions.phrase: В этом миге была вся радость.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location in time. 'Миге' takes the prepositional after 'в', placing the joy within the moment. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Миг' is the inanimate accusative measuring how long the happiness lasted. 'Один' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'всего' stresses brevity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Миги' is the nominative plural subject of 'пролетели'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'быстро' describes the fleeting time.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Мигов' is the genitive plural after 'из', describing what life is made of. 'Таких' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Миг' takes the accusative after 'через' to mean after a moment. The inanimate form matches the nominative, and 'тронулся' starts the motion.
